configure_jupyter_ip: configure the Jupyter NotebookApp to bind to IP 0.0.0.0 for remote access
configure_jupyter_port: configure the Jupyter NotebookApp port using the PORT environment variable defaulting to 8888
configure_jupyter_no_browser: configure the Jupyter NotebookApp to not open a browser on startup
configure_jupyter_password: configure the Jupyter NotebookApp password using the PASSWORD environment variable with IPython passwd hashing
configure_jupyter_no_auth: configure the Jupyter NotebookApp to disable password and token auth when PASSWORD env var is empty
